results.title: Dr. Anmol Srivastava | HCI | Designer - Creative Interfaces Lab
results.content: Dr. Anmol Srivastava is an HCI designer focused on leveraging emerging technologies to enhance utility, usability, and creative self-expression. His doctoral research earned several accolades, including national and international travel grants and prestigious awards. In 2017, he represented the SIGCHI community and the future of HCI research as an ACM SIGCHI Student Ambassador from India at the 50th Turing Award Ceremony in San Francisco. * **Assistant Professor** at HCD, IIITD, New Delhi (Jan 2023 – Present). * **Assistant Professor**, School of Design, UPES, Dehradun (Oct 2018 – Jan 2023). #### Awards and Grants. * 2023 Teaching Excellence Award, IIITD. * 2021 Nominated for Best Researcher Award, UPES. * 2017 Student Ambassador from India at the 50th ACM Turing Award Ceremony, USA. * Principal Member from IIITD, Bureau of Indian Standards, LITDC – Panel 8/ Metaverse. * Placement Coordinator; Student Mentor Program Coordinator – HCD, IIITD. * Member – ACM SIGCHI, HCI Professional Association of India.
